changelog: [Role]: Added an explicit, non-negotiable requirement that output must never be empty or partial — if no safe split exists, the full original input must be echoed unchanged. This directly targets the format_violation case (empty seg_text) without touching Decision Procedure, which was already tried and rejected for this exact issue.

[Core Principles]: Added a 'format integrity' principle stating every character of the input must appear in the output (as plain text or around <SEG> tags), reinforcing completeness at the principle level rather than adding new segmentation logic, per the 'fix output format' direction which prohibits new segmentation restrictions.
